faq-item.faq-q: What is the difference between an AI agent developer and a general AI developer?
faq-item.faq-a: An AI agent developer specializes in agentic architectures, tool use, memory, and multi-step reasoning systems. A general AI developer may cover a broader range including model training, computer vision, or MLOps. For a project specifically about building an autonomous agent that reasons and acts, an agent specialist brings deeper, focused expertise.

faq-item.faq-q: How much does it cost to hire a freelance AI agent developer?
faq-item.faq-a: A scoped proof-of-concept typically starts at $1,500 to $4,000. A full production agent with tool integrations and guardrails ranges from $8,000 to $30,000 depending on complexity. Hourly consulting runs $75 to $150/hr.

faq-item.faq-q: Should I hire one freelance AI agent developer or a dedicated team?
faq-item.faq-a: For a single, well-scoped AI agent system, one experienced freelance developer is typically faster to start and more cost-effective. If your roadmap spans multiple concurrent AI disciplines and needs sustained, embedded team capacity, a dedicated team provider like AtlasML is better matched to that scale.

faq-item.faq-q: How long does it take to build an AI agent?
faq-item.faq-a: A proof-of-concept typically takes 2 to 4 weeks. A full production agent with tools, memory, guardrails, and deployment typically takes 4 to 10 weeks depending on task complexity and integration scope.
